items.title: KSU Football to Honor Military Community Through Operation Hat Trick and Salute to Service Game
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State Athletics will honor the men and women who have served and continue to serve our country as part of KSU Football's Salute to Service game against FIU on Saturday, Nov. 21 at Walens Family Field at Fifth Third Stadium.

items.title: Kennesaw State Athletics Provides Design Update on Wellstar Champions Complex
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State Athletics announced Wednesday that the schematic design phase has been completed for the Wellstar Champions Complex, the 55,000-square-foot future daily home for Kennesaw State football.
